description:
SendRaven is email infrastructure for AI agents. Connected to ChatGPT, it sends email from your own domain, reads the replies as threaded conversations, and answers in the same thread, so a conversation that starts in chat continues in the recipient's inbox.

Use SendRaven to:
- See which conversations are waiting for a reply, open a thread, and answer it in place.
- Send a one-off email, or a saved template with its variables filled in.
- Check whether an email was delivered, bounced, opened or clicked.
- Manage contacts, audiences, suppressions and marketing campaigns.

Built for an assistant acting on your behalf: every received message shows whether its sender passed DMARC or DKIM, and outgoing email can be held for your approval before anything is sent. Requires a SendRaven account with a verified sending domain.

defaultPrompt: What emails are still waiting for my reply?
Summarize my latest customer thread and draft a reply.
How did my last emails do? Show deliveries and bounces.

positive.description: Find the conversations that still need an answer. The demo workspace has a customer thread titled "Can I change the email address on my account?" waiting for a reply.
positive.prompt: Which emails in my SendRaven inbox are still waiting for a reply?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the threads with awaiting_reply=true, including "Can I change the email address on my account?", with sender and last-message time. Nothing is sent or changed.

positive.description: Open one conversation and summarise it, without replying.
positive.prompt: Open the thread about changing the email address on an account and summarise what the customer is asking.
positive.expected_behavior: A short summary of the customer's request taken from the thread's messages, noting whether the sender is authenticated. No reply is sent.

positive.description: Preview a template with variables filled in.
positive.prompt: Preview the order-shipped template for Ana with order number A-1042.
positive.expected_behavior: The rendered subject "Your order A-1042 has shipped" and the body with first_name=Ana. Nothing is sent.

positive.description: Check plan usage and whether sending is currently allowed.
positive.prompt: How many emails have I sent this month on SendRaven, and can I still send?
positive.expected_behavior: The plan (Free), emails used and remaining out of 3,000 for the current period, the period dates, and that sending is not locked.

positive.description: Send a test email to Amazon SES's delivery simulator, a safe address that accepts mail and delivers it nowhere. ChatGPT should confirm before sending because the tool is open-world.
positive.prompt: Send a short test email from hello@mail.demo.sendraven.ai to success@simulator.amazonses.com with the subject "ChatGPT test" saying that the connection works.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms, the email is accepted and the response shows its id, status and thread_id.

negative.description: A writing request with nothing to send. ChatGPT can draft the text itself; SendRaven should only be used when the user asks to actually send or reply.
negative.prompt: Help me write a polite email to my landlord asking them to fix the heating.

negative.description: A personal mailbox SendRaven has no access to. SendRaven only sees mail received on domains verified in the user's SendRaven workspace, not Gmail or Outlook.
negative.prompt: What's in my Gmail inbox today?

negative.description: General email-marketing advice that needs no account data.
negative.prompt: What are the best ways to improve email open rates?
